caseNameFull: Fields S. Pendleton v. Benner Line
attorneys: Mr. Avery F. Cushman and Mr. Harvey D. Goulder for the petitioner. Mr. D. Roger Englar for the respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of cer-tiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit granted, conditioned on the petitioner furnishing a bond within twenty days in an amount to secure payment of the judgment, the amount of the bond to be satisfactory to the circuit-justice and to be approved by him.
